title: 5.4.9 Challenges: Make it yours
description: The game is complete. Change one rule of your own: a narrower gap, pipes that speed up with the score, or a best score that survives a crash. Pick one, or invent one.

steps.title: Pick a rule and change it
steps.instructions: Choose one of the three challenges on the page above, or invent a rule of your own. Start from your finished 5.4.7.
hints: Whatever you pick, press R afterwards and check the game still starts cleanly.

steps.title: Name what you changed
steps.instructions: Write one sentence in the notes under the editor saying what your rule is and what would happen if you removed it.
hints: A rule is something the game decides. 'The gap shrinks every five points' is a rule; 'I changed a colour' is not.

requirements.title: The game gets harder as the score grows
requirements.description: Something read in makePipe or the loop depends on the score. Help: 5.4.6 (Lab: Score a gap)

requirements.title: The best score survives a crash
requirements.description: A second number is kept across rounds and updated when the score beats it. Help: 5.3.9 (Lab: Lose, and start again)

requirements.title: Something about the pipes is random
requirements.description: The pipes use random for more than the gap height. Help: 5.4.5 (Lab: Pipes that come and go)
